input.summary: Cut the Company's non-renewal notice window in Section 4.1 to 60 days while leaving HDI's exit notice at 90 days.
input.comment: [Playbook] We reduced the notice the Company must give to stop an automatic renewal to 60 days, which is our fallback position (preferred is 30 days plus an HDI reminder 60 days before renewal), and left HDI's own exit notice at 90 days so we keep transition runway. The one-year renewal term and the fixed fee in Section 3.1 (no renewal uplift) are acceptable as drafted.

ops.oldText: unless terminated by either Party hereto upon ninety (90) days written notice to the other.
ops.newText: unless terminated by the Company upon 60 days written notice to HDI, or by HDI upon ninety (90) days written notice.
